notes:
DodaZip v0.2.0 Feature Release:
- Windows Explorer Context Menu integration (Extract Here, Extract to subfolder, Open in DodaZip)
- Multi-threaded CPU & Compression Speed Benchmark utility (Zstd compression/decompression MB/s & BLAKE3 throughput)
- High-definition 3D compression icon for application & .dzip files
- Extended File & Folder metadata attributes (Type, Date Modified, Attributes) with multi-column sorting
- Redesigned Master-Detail vertical sidebar Settings dialog with dynamic version reporting
- Expanded 88-language localization suite
